Grades 7–9 · High School · Adult

3D Design & Printing

Future pathway · Register interest

Start with shapes and dimensions, then explore fit, function and iteration. Printing becomes one step in a thoughtful design process.

Explore this program →

Grades 7–9 · High School · Adult

DTF Printing

Future pathway · Register interest

Learn how direct-to-film (DTF) printing turns a digital design into a durable, full-colour transfer that can be pressed onto fabric. Understand the process from file prep to finished press.

Explore this program →

Grades 7–9 · High School · Adult

UV Printing

Future pathway · Register interest

Learn how UV printers apply ink directly onto rigid or flexible surfaces—like acrylic, wood or metal—and cure it instantly with UV light. Explore how material, ink layers and finish affect the result.

Explore this program →

Adult

Robotics for Adults

Future workshops · Register interest

A hands-on introduction to robotics for adult beginners—build a working robot, write the code that drives it, and get comfortable with the tools, without needing a technical background.

Explore this program →

High School · Adult

IELTS Preparation

Future pathway · Register interest

Work through the Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking sections of the IELTS exam, with practice tasks and feedback aimed at a clear target band score.

Explore this program →
